name: session-chime
description: Chimes when a session finishes or needs you, and keeps an inbox of waiting sessions you can click to switch to.

minSeconds.title: Minimum turn length (seconds)
minSeconds.description: Turns shorter than this finish silently. Needs-input pings always sound.

autoOpenInbox.title: Open the inbox on a new ping
autoOpenInbox.description: Open the Sessions waiting pane when any session finishes or needs you.
